description: Summarize a pasted English status update to two sentences; keep service name, count and time. EXAM-CANARY-9be81a02

turns.prompt:
Can you boil this down to two sentences for my manager?

At 09:12 this morning the payments-api service started returning 502 errors after a config push. On-call rolled the config back by 09:40, but 41 checkout attempts failed during that window and a handful of customers were charged twice. Finance has been notified and will refund the duplicates; we are adding a canary step to the config pipeline so a bad push gets caught before it reaches all instances.
